subject.title: Model configuration accepts unvalidated model names, enabling silent misconfiguration

question: Should unknown configured model refs be warning-only `config validate`/doctor findings, hard validation errors, or runtime-only diagnostics when catalog authority may be incomplete?
rationale: The code can enumerate the affected refs, but the behavior changes upgrade semantics for custom providers, forward-compatible model names, fallback behavior, and config writes, so automation should not choose the policy alone.

options.title: Warning-first validation
options.body: Add runtime-equivalent doctor/config warnings for unknown or unverifiable configured refs while avoiding hard failures for custom and forward-compatible setups by default.

options.title: Strict validation
options.body: Reject unknown configured refs during config validation or config writes, accepting a compatibility break unless a separate escape or migration contract is approved.

options.title: Runtime-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep config validation permissive and improve startup/runtime/fallback diagnostics instead of adding a new semantic config analyzer.

recommendation.title: Warning-first validation
recommendation.body: Add runtime-equivalent doctor/config warnings for unknown or unverifiable configured refs while avoiding hard failures for custom and forward-compatible setups by default.
